name: Summit
source:
"In a world full of the supernatural, what story could unfold?"

Summit is a VN based in a world that is in the invisible grip of an army of Demons, supernatural creatures who's collective goal is to enslave the world and turn its denizens into cattle waiting for the slaughter. You play as one of the few people to be made aware of this hidden world, and join a group of people dedicated to fighting these Demons.

[From [url=https://apropos0.itch.io/summit]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“在一个充满超自然存在的世界里，会展开怎样的故事？”

《Summit》的舞台，是一个被恶魔军团暗中掌控的世界。这些超自然生物有着共同的目标：奴役整个世界，将其中的居民变成待宰的牲畜。你将扮演少数知晓这个隐秘世界的人之一，加入一群致力于对抗恶魔的伙伴。

[摘自[url=https://apropos0.itch.io/summit]Itch.io[/url]]
